items.title: Duke Energy awards more than $50,000 in emergency grants to support Indiana storm recovery
items.summary: Duke Energy and its foundation are reaching out to its communities affected by last week’s historic floods with more than $50,000 in emergency grants.

items.title: NOAA confirms hottest month on record across the contiguous U.S.
items.summary: As high temperatures continue across much of North Carolina and South Carolina, Duke Energy is reminding customers about tools that can help them stay informed about their energy use and connect them with assistance programs if they need help.

items.title: Duke Energy Foundation launches $175,000 Main Street Revitalization grant program to support South Carolina communities
items.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is investing $175,000 in South Carolina communities through its Main Street Revitalization grant program to support projects that enhance downtown districts, neighborhood centers and commercial corridors across the state.

items.title: Duke Energy thanks Greater Cincinnati customers for their patience and support as storm workers restored power after rare derecho
items.summary: More than 2,000 electric lineworkers, tree trimmers and support personnel helped restore more than 340,000 customer power outages across Greater Cincinnati after multiple severe storms caused widespread damage throughout the region last week.

items.title: Duke Energy’s resource plan builds on work already underway that supports South Carolina’s growth while delivering value to customers
items.summary: Duke Energy’s 2026 Carolinas Resource Plan – submitted Aug. 14 to the Public Service Commission of South Carolina (PSCSC) – reflects execution already underway and highlights new opportunities to power South Carolina’s future.

items.title: Duke Energy restores 85% of Greater Cincinnati outages; crews on track to restore nearly all remaining outages Thursday
items.summary: Duke Energy crews have restored nearly 223,000 outages across Greater Cincinnati since the first of several major storm systems caused severe destruction across the region less than 48 hours ago.

items.title: Duke Energy ha restablecido el servicio en el 85% de los cortes de energía en Greater Cincinnati; los equipos de trabajo prevén restablecer casi todos los cortes de energía restantes este día jueves
items.summary: Los equipos de Duke Energy han restablecido el servicio eléctrico en casi 223.000 hogares en Greater Cincinnati desde que, hace 48 horas, el primero de varios sistemas de tormentas importantes causó graves daños en toda la región.

items.title: Duke Energy invests $500,000 to help small businesses grow across North Carolina
items.summary: § Twenty nonprofits will provide microgrants and business support to hundreds of local entrepreneurs across the state § Grants are a continuation of North Carolina small businesses support, with over $3 million since 2020 Charlotte, N.C. – The Duke...

items.title: Duke Energy Foundation awards emergency grants to support severe weather recovery in Ohio and Kentucky
items.summary: In response to the severe storms that swept across Ohio and Kentucky, the Duke Energy Foundation is providing emergency grant funding to local nonprofit organizations supporting relief and recovery efforts in impacted areas.

items.title: Duke Energy restores more than 171,000 outages across Greater Cincinnati, repairs continue as company works to determine restoration times
items.summary: Over the past 24 hours, Duke Energy workers have restored power to more than 171,000 customers across Greater Cincinnati despite multiple rounds of severe weather, fallen trees, road closures and extensive damage to the electric system.

items.title: Duke Energy restablece el servicio en más de 171.000 hogares afectados por cortes de electricidad en Greater Cincinnati; las reparaciones continúan mientras la compañía trabaja para determinar los tiempos de restablecimiento
items.summary: En las últimas 24 horas, los trabajadores de Duke Energy han restablecido el servicio eléctrico a más de 171.000 clientes en todo Greater Cincinnati, a pesar de las múltiples oleadas de clima severo, los árboles caídos, los cierres de carreteras y los daños considerables en el sistema eléctrico.

items.title: More than 160,000 Duke Energy customers in Ohio and Kentucky remain without power as second round of storms is expected
items.summary: Duke Energy crews have been working quickly and safely to assess damage, clear debris and restore power after severe storms caused major destruction across Greater Cincinnati on Tuesday.

items.title: Duke Energy and Piedmont Natural Gas urge everyone to call 811 before digging
items.summary: Aug. 11 is National Safe Digging Day (also known as 811 Day) and Duke Energy and Piedmont Natural Gas are advising customers and excavators to call 811 at least three business days before beginning any outdoor project that involves digging.

items.title: Duke Energy announces pricing of equity units offering
items.summary: Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE: DUK) announced the pricing of its public offering of 35 million Equity Units.

items.title: Duke Energy announces equity units offering
items.summary: Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE: DUK) today announced it plans to sell 35 million equity units in a public offering.

items.title: Duke Energy Florida, Sea Turtle Conservancy and Clearwater Marine Aquarium Return to Treasure Island to Mark Progress in Protecting Hatchlings
items.summary: Duke Energy Florida, Sea Turtle Conservancy and Clearwater Marine Aquarium returned to Treasure Island to review progress in protecting sea turtles through wildlife friendly outdoor lighting.

items.title: Duke Energy is helping North Carolina customers manage energy costs during extreme summer heat
items.summary: With hotter weather expected across North Carolina next week, Duke Energy is helping customers manage energy use, better understand their bills and access assistance if needed.

items.title: Duke Energy Progress reaches agreement with North Carolina Public Staff and other stakeholders to deliver a lower-cost path to power North Carolina’s future
items.summary: After listening carefully to customer and stakeholder feedback, Duke Energy Progress and stakeholders have reached an agreement that will allow the company to continue building the infrastructure needed to reliably serve North Carolina while reducing the proposed rate increase by more than half.

items.title: What Duke Energy Florida customers need to know as summer heat peaks in August
items.summary: With the hottest month of the year underway, Duke Energy Florida is offering important reminders about what it takes to keep the power flowing, as well as energy efficiency resources to help its more than 2 million customers save money.

items.title: Duke Energy reports second-quarter 2026 financial results
items.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE: DUK) has posted its second-quarter 2026 financial results in a news release available on the company's website at the following link: duke-energy.com/investors.

items.title: Duke Energy Foundation provides $300,000 in grants to support organizations serving older South Carolinians
items.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is providing $300,000 in grants to South Carolina organizations to expand support for housing, nutrition and other essential services for older residents amid growing demand for support.

items.title: Duke Energy surpasses $65 million in North Carolina customer assistance with new $1 million investment in nonprofits
items.summary: Duke Energy Foundation invests $1 million to expand food access, housing stability, senior services and utility assistance for families, seniors and vulnerable residents.

items.title: Duke Energy: Data center growth will deliver billions of dollars in customer savings
items.summary: With the Customer Protection Plus framework, Duke Energy is committed to responsibly managing growth while maintaining reliability and creating customer benefits.

items.title: Duke Energy Carolinas reaches agreement with North Carolina Public Staff and other stakeholders to deliver a lower-cost path to power North Carolina’s future
items.summary: After listening carefully to customer and stakeholder feedback, Duke Energy Carolinas and stakeholders have reached an agreement that will allow the company to continue building the infrastructure needed to reliably serve North Carolina while reducing the proposed rate increase by more than half.

items.title: Sign up, sit back, save: Duke Energy Florida program offers bill credits with minimal requirements, little effort needed from customers
items.summary: Duke Energy Florida’s EnergyWise Home program offers up to $141 in annual bill credits for homeowners and renters.

items.title: Duke Energy announces dividend payments to shareholders
items.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE: DUK) today declared a quarterly cash dividend on its common stock of $1.085 per share, an increase of $0.02.

items.title: Piedmont Natural Gas awards nearly $60,000 in grants to combat hunger, housing insecurity in the Charlotte region
items.summary: As part of its efforts to power the vitality of the communities it serves, Piedmont Natural Gas, through the Duke Energy Foundation, has awarded nearly $60,000 in grants to support the missions of three organizations combating hunger and housing insecurity in Charlotte and the surrounding area.

items.title: Duke Energy Florida’s Neighborhood Energy Saver Program saves Clearwater customers over $3.1M to date
items.summary: From the grocery store to the gas pump, household budgets are stretched thin. To help provide relief, Duke Energy Florida’s Neighborhood Energy Saver Program has been offered in the city of Clearwater since the start of the year.

items.title: Duke Energy Florida delivers $50 million in customer savings, avoids 2027 base rate increase through innovative tax strategy
items.summary: Duke Energy Florida is delivering $50 million in customer savings in 2027.

items.title: Indiana customers to receive $350,000 in bill assistance from Duke Energy this summer
items.summary: Duke Energy is dedicating $350,000 in financial assistance to help Indiana customers pay their energy bills this summer. This assistance comes from the company’s “Summer Energy Assistance Credit Program,” which is funded by Duke Energy shareholders.

items.title: Duke Energy to announce second-quarter 2026 financial results on Aug. 4
items.summary: Duke Energy will post its second-quarter 2026 financial results at 7 a.m. ET on Tuesday, Aug. 4, on the company’s website at duke-energy.com/investors

items.title: Duke Energy Foundation invests $773,000 to strengthen STEM education in Florida
items.summary: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. – The Duke Energy Foundation is awarding $773,000 to 22 nonprofit organizations and higher education institutions working to strengthen STEM education by expanding access to hands-on learning opportunities and helping prepare Florida...

items.title: Duke Energy’s nearly $1 billion investment with North Carolina suppliers strengthens American supply chains, local economies and the nation’s energy future
items.summary: As the nation approaches Independence Day, Duke Energy is investing in American suppliers to help power local economies, support customer value and build the energy infrastructure needed to serve growing communities.

items.title: New this summer: An easier way to understand your energy bill
items.summary: Duke Energy's new AI-powered Bill Insights helps Carolinas customers understand what’s driving their summer energy costs

items.title: Duke Energy, City of Pinellas Park team up to help local residents save energy and money this summer
items.summary: With summer officially underway, Duke Energy and the City of Pinellas Park are launching a joint awareness campaign encouraging local residents to complete a free Home Energy Check and get personalized recommendations to help them save energy – and money.

items.title: Duke Energy Foundation completes more than $550,000 in grants to South Carolina organizations celebrating nation’s 250th birthday
items.summary: As America’s 250th anniversary approaches this Fourth of July, Duke Energy Foundation is providing more than $260,000 in grants to South Carolina organizations to help preserve local history and expand civic learning across the Palmetto State. This is the final round of the Foundation’s America250 initiative, completing a $550,000 investment in South Carolina tied to the nation’s anniversary focused on community-driven projects.

items.title: Duke Energy expands access to local history and civic learning across North Carolina through America250 grants
items.summary: As the country approaches its 250th birthday, the Duke Energy Foundation is distributing $186,100 to 16 nonprofit organizations across North Carolina that are working to expand access to civic learning and remembrance.

items.title: Duke Energy Florida’s redfish released into Crystal River waters alongside Citrus County, CCA Florida; anglers encouraged to catch them for cash prizes
items.summary: This weekend, Duke Energy Florida joined Citrus County and Coastal Conservation Association (CCA) Florida to release 100 redfish at the Pirates Cove Park in Crystal River.

items.title: Summer starts June 21: Duke Energy Florida highlights five key appliances to help customers manage energy use
items.summary: While summer heat has already settled across Florida, the astronomical start of the season is observed this Sunday, June 21. Duke Energy Florida is helping customers manage their energy use – and their bills – by offering practical tips focused on the five appliances that use the most energy in the home: air conditioners, water heaters, refrigerators, washing machines and dishwashers.

items.title: Duke Energy Foundation grants $77,500 to expand access to civic learning and remembrance across Florida
items.summary: As part of the final round of grants through the Duke Energy Foundation’s America250 initiative, $77,500 is being distributed to seven nonprofit organizations across Florida that are working to expand access to civic learning and remembrance.

items.title: Duke Energy Foundation completes America250 grantmaking with 54 grants expanding access to local history and civic learning
items.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is awarding nearly $830,000 in 54 grants to nonprofit organizations, cultural institutions and community partners in North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, Indiana, Ohio and Kentucky.

items.title: Duke Energy joins national Careers Electric™ coalition to build next-generation energy workforce
items.summary: Duke Energy has joined a new coalition of industry, education, government and NPO partners through the Siemens Foundation’s Careers Electric initiative to help close the electrician shortage gap.

items.title: Piedmont Natural Gas lowers rates, saving North Carolina residential customers $100 per year
items.summary: Piedmont Natural Gas today announced it has decreased rates for its North Carolina customers. Combined, Piedmont’s 2026 rate decreases are reducing average residential customers’ bills by approximately 8%, or about $100, per year.

items.title: Duke Energy offers tips to save energy and money as temperatures rise in the Carolinas
items.summary: High temperatures are forecast across the Carolinas this weekend and next week, and Duke Energy has tips to help you take control of your energy use while keeping you and your family cool.

items.title: Duke Energy supports South Carolina first responders with $500,000 in grants for emergency preparedness
items.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is awarding $500,000 through the 2026 Helping Emergency Response Organizations (HERO) Grant Program to help South Carolina communities be prepared for the impacts from severe weather. More than 30 organizations are receiving grants that will fund training, life-saving equipment and innovative technology identified as needs following severe weather events – all aimed to aid in weather-related disaster planning and recovery efforts.

items.title: The DOE announces grants for Duke Energy projects, bringing total funding to nearly $96 million
items.summary: As the latest effort to save customers money while meeting rising demand, DOE funding would support needed refurbishment at North Carolina and Kentucky power plants to strengthen reliability.

items.title: Duke Energy offers $500,000 to support small businesses across North Carolina
items.summary: The Duke Energy Foundation is offering $500,000 in grants to support nonprofit-led programs that help small businesses like restaurants and retail stores complete renovations, buy equipment or technology, purchase inventory or meet other business needs.

items.title: Duke Energy site readiness efforts help land $1.2 billion advanced manufacturing project in Cherokee County
items.summary: USA Rare Earth’s announcement of a major investment and new jobs in Cherokee County highlights the impact of Duke Energy’s Site Readiness Program, which helped prepare the Bailey Industrial Site for major economic development.

items.title: Duke Energy Florida is ready for 2026 hurricane season following continued grid hardening investments
items.summary: As the 2026 hurricane season begins today, Duke Energy Florida is reinforcing its commitment to reliability and storm response following continued investments in grid hardening efforts.

items.title: Duke Energy Florida implements third rate reduction to lower residential customer bills by approximately 25% in 2026
items.summary: Duke Energy Florida will implement its third rate reduction of 2026 from June through September, lowering residential customer bills by approximately $50, or 25%, for every 1,000 kilowatt-hours (kWh) of energy used when compared to January.
